blurb: Polaris Slingshot is a three-wheeled, open-air roadster that was first introduced in 2014. It is manufactured by Polaris Industries, an American company that specializes in off-road vehicles, snowmobiles, and motorcycles. The Slingshot is unique in its class because it has two seats side-by-side instead of the traditional motorcycle layout with the rider sitting behind the passenger. It also has a steering wheel instead of handlebars, giving it more of a car-like feel.
